WHAT: DataDome anti-bot blocks POST /api/v2/photos even with valid cookies + CSRF token, because DataDome requires client-side JS execution to generate its cookie.

CONFIRMED NOT WORKING:
- requests/urllib3 with copied headers → 403
- cloudscraper → 406 (blocked at page load)
- fetch from Chrome console → 403 (DataDome detects automation context)
- curl with cookies from requests session → 400/500

ROOT CAUSE: DataDome cookie isn't present when we scrape — it's generated by DataDome's JS. Without it, the server rejects the upload.

THREE OPTIONS FOR BYPASS:
1. Playwright with stealth plugin
   - Pro: Reliable, industry standard
   - Con: ~50MB overhead, slow cold start
   
2. Proxy through user's browser
   - Frontend opens hidden iframe or popup to vinted.com
   - Uses Vinted's real UI to upload, captures UUID from URL change
   - Pro: Zero server overhead, always works
   - Con: UX friction, iframe CORS restrictions may block
   
3. capsolver.com or similar
   - Paid DataDome solving service
   - Pro: Lightweight, fast
   - Con: Cost, dependency on third party

NOTE: The search step (GET /api/v2/catalog/items?search_by_image_uuid=) works fine without DataDome.
